inventory.anchor: includes; AdapterInfo::IsFallbackAdapter; a forward declaration of ToJsKey; Adapter::Adapter after the feature loop; Adapter::RequestDevice before wgpu_client_request_device
inventory.notes: Calls only: the declared features, limits and fallback answer, and the clamp of what is sent to wgpu, all in dom/webgpu/StealthWebGPUDeclaration.cpp. ToJsKey is Adapter.cpp's own static; it is forward-declared so the declaration is keyed by the names the page reads.

inventory.anchor: includes; Instance::RequestAdapter before and after wgpu_client_request_adapter
inventory.notes: A declared GPU without Direct3D 12 resolves requestAdapter with null; otherwise the request notes forceFallbackAdapter for the adapter's isFallbackAdapter.
The LUID out parameter is zeroed before Mozilla's code fills it: a missing compositor device reads as no match, not uninitialised memory.
Registers our file on lines of its own, outside Mozilla's list; non-unified because it has file-static helpers with short names.

inventory.anchor: after #include "gfxPlatform.h"; gfxPlatform::InitWebGPUConfig, before the WEBGPU_EXTERNAL_TEXTURE force-disable
evidence: +  mozilla::webgpu::StealthWebGPUPlatformInit();  // STEALTH-HOOK(fingerprint/webgpu/adapter-declaration): Linux's Vulkan driver is ours; external textures are on as on Windows
inventory.notes: StealthWebGPUPlatformInit maps the bundled lavapipe (<exe dir>/lavapipe/libvulkan_lvp.so) under the Vulkan loader's name before wgpu opens it, and turns WebGPU off when it cannot (fail closed, never a host driver). The force-disable of WebGPU external textures off Windows and macOS is compiled out: the engine presents Windows on every OS, where the feature is on, and the import runs on the shared-memory buffer path.

inventory.anchor: after the instance_flags statement of wgpu_server_new (with_env), and after the Windows compositor-LUID block of Message::RequestAdapter; each line declares, in its own block, the path module it calls
inventory.notes: With the engine on, the instance flags are the ones built with no WGPU_* variable set (stealth_webgpu_env::without_host_env), and a compositor search that found no D3D12 adapter takes the software one (WARP) instead of answering null (stealth_webgpu_adapter::settle).

inventory.anchor: dom.webgpu.external-texture.enabled and javascript.options.use_fdlibm_for_sin_cos_tan, the non-Windows value of each
evidence: +  value: true  # STEALTH-HOOK(fingerprint/webgpu/adapter-declaration): Windows' value on every OS
+  value: false  # STEALTH-HOOK(fingerprint/fonts/idwr): Windows' value; libxul's sin/cos/tan are ucrtbase's (gfx/idwr/libm_ucrt.c)
inventory.notes: Mozilla's value changed on its own line, as the prefs-declared-once rule asks: the pref is declared nowhere else. Same for the second line, owned by fingerprint/fonts/idwr (one record per file, so the file stays here): with javascript.options.use_fdlibm_for_sin_cos_tan false on every OS, Math.sin/cos/tan call the libm names libxul now defines itself (gfx/idwr/libm_ucrt.c, ucrtbase's results) instead of fdlibm.
